text: I  got a peanut tray  the potato's and sausage where good and peanuts where okay, staff was nice and the place was really clean. I'd order online next time just to cut down on the wait time but it wasn't that bad. I'd try something else next time
We had the BBQ Hawaiian with onion rings and the Southwest burger with sweet potato fries. The sandwiches were great but the sides were only ok. Still a great place for lunch.

I stopped here after finding out that new owners took over.  The owner was extremely friendly and offered me a sample of some pasta that they will be offering for sale in the coming weeks.  Pasta was fantastic and tastes like something I would have eaten at great restaurants up north.      I cannot wait for him to put it on the menu.

Also, they still have all the items from the original menu and my chicken and mushroom sandwich was top notch and better than ever.

I came here for the first time to celebrate my GFs birthday. They were maintaining social distancing guidelines which is good, and the atmosphere/ambiance was definitely nice. This can be a romantic date spot if necessary. Now to the food: my food was so-so (pictured), it was very bland, honestly. It definitely needed some seasoning. My GF said her tuna (also pictured) was very good and she definitely enjoyed it. The waiter was nice, but slow. I won't return unless a friend wants to meet there but that's mainly bc of the distance (30mins). If I do come back, I'm definitely trying a different fish

I can't understand why this place has so many good reviews. The sushi was some of the worst I've ever had. The cucumber in the shrimp tempura roll was practically rotten and the shrimp was overly breaded and cold. The sushi rice was bland, under-seasoned and cold. The tuna was flavorless and grainy. Out of three people in our group, no one wanted to finish their meal. 

The staff was also weirdly apathetic in stark contrast to the blasting Kpop.

There's absolutely no reason to come back to this place. McCaffrey's has better sushi.
The ice cream was delicious! My boyfriend and I had never been before and the lady working was friendly and answered all of my questions. Will definitely be my go to ice cream shop when I'm in Reno!

After many recommendations by my co-workers and based on all the reviews, I finally dropped in to order some food. Now I don't know if it's because I've been eating grocery food for the past month, but everything from this place was amazing. I ordered the classic general t'so chicken and lo mein and a whole lot of sushi. Let me tell you guys, the sushi here is fantastic...I saw some reviews about the cheapness of their rice and quality so I wasn't expecting much but I definitely did not see cheapness when I ordered. The rolls had a generous amount of rice and the fish was fresh, overall I'd say this restaurant is not cheap in its ingredients so I don't know what the other review was talking about...Not only is their sushi extremely good, their chinese options are also above average. I'm super glad I decided to try this place out, they just gained another customer.

I went here with my girlfriend as avid seafood lovers. Let me just say there is a great charm to this place. If you are a creole seafood fan you will feel right at home here. Really nice people work here and really great food. The lobster was a little pricey, but wow the tilapia was great! All the platters come with a ton of veggies and delicious seasoning. 100% coming back to this place!

Really cannot say enough about how delicious this downtown St. Louis Mexican restaurant was yesterday. The place was absolutely packed before the XFL game, waits were running from 30-45 minutes and not too many people were walking out which was my first peek into the potential for great cuisine.

Our server (Jake) was extremely friendly even though he was slammed with tables and we did not wait long for water refills and multiple drink orders.

I was with a party of four; chicken nachos, taco burger and a few different street tacos for my company. I went with the Porky Pig bowl and an Al Pastor street taco. The street taco was sublime, with a fresh pop and rich flavors.  My bowl accidentally came out as a burrito but by the time I had finished my taco a fresh bowl was brought out so zero complaints here (it happens).

The real winner though for the entire table was the unlimited chips and salsa...the best chips and verde salsa I have had in years (maybe ever). I ate so much that I could have skipped my entree - honestly that great! The chips had the perfect crunch and warmth, along with a salsa that tasted like crushed lines inside of pico!

My entire party would easily go back even though I am the extreme lover of Mexican cuisine, they were simply entertaining my obsession!

Love this place for breakfast! It's always busy but I can usually pop in and get two seats at the bar pretty quickly. I always get eggs Benedict and their hollandaise sauce is great!  Also love their coffee.

Parking is on the street or in a lot nearby. Usually pretty easy to find. Don't forget to pay the meter though!


Love the old time feel of this great diner!
I was so excited to eat at this new restaurant.  I order lo mein Chicken and egg rolls.  The egg rolls were delicious but the lo mein was the worst I have ever had.
Very personable.  Great service. He brought my order out to my car. I'm trying to go to local businesses.  This is my first time at Beefy's. The food was excellent.

During my NOLA vacation, I enjoyed eating at this popeye's location. I tried their fried chickens, sides & mardi gras king pie. Everything I ordered was fresh, hot, crispy and well seasoned. I enjoyed all the foods here & so did my family. Staff was also very friendly as well.

I wanted to love Basso so much. The interior is SO cute and romantic, and pasta is one of my favorite things on the planet. The service was wonderful, and their truffle fries smack. But no one in my group of three loved their pasta. You can tell the pasta is made in house, but I found my strozzapreti to be just spicy and not much else flavor-wise. While I think there are better places in the Lou for pasta, I'd go back to try a pizza to see if those are a better option here!
Only 1 piece of over-cooked, very dry chicken in fried chicken dinner?? Salty collard greens.

Me and my father decided to have lunch today at one of his favorite restaurants he's very cheap like me with that being said we decided to dine at this China buffet for $ 7.99 you definitely pay for what you get the food had NO taste on top of that EVERYTHING was cold I started to say something to the manager who is also the owner I realized he was speaking to a young lady who was from the health department I decided to keep my opinion to myself and just eat the food I could see the owner was having a issue so I did not want to bring anymore problems his way if you ever want to grab something to eat and really don't care about the price or the taste then this restaurant is for you.

It is a shame that our favorite pizza place that we order from bi-weekly gave another disappointing experience. Customer service seems to have gone by the wayside- and that's from the owner himself. 
Times are hard as we know, so honor your promotions, and be friendly when you don't!
Really good pizza. We had the pepperoni and margherita. The people were super nice as well.  I would definitely go back.
Abosolutly terrible service worst Applebee's out there. Food was undercooked, and also found hair in my food.

This place is amazing. I live in the Bay Area, which is one of the best places on Earth to love eating, so I rarely find myself wishing I "could find something like this back home." But dammit, Alice, you've got me dreaming about Philly. 

Alice Pizza offers a slew of thin, toppings-forward pizzas that you purchase by the ounce (so if you're dazzled by the selection and can't choose, you can talk yourself into buying an inch of several!). I got an eggplant, a Philly special, and a spicy tomato. All were delicious, and I was both satisfied and pretty full for under $7. 

They offer a wide selection of gelato also. I got the tiramisu, which was okay. Truth told, the gelato tasted super boozy. Perhaps they should sell this with a warning. :)

I was eyeing the cannoli here but didn't leave any space for it. Next time, Alice!

If I could give a zero review I would we flew from Baltimore to tucson to take our 99 year old friend out for her birthday and mothers day.  What we we ended up with was a visit to a restaurant without leadership and no food served until we actually were walking out the door.  Until management gets their act in  hear I would avoid this restaurant

Paid a good amount of money for a very cheap salad that was mostly full of the white hard pieces from iceberg lettuce. Because we were drinking alcohol I think we got the tail end of service and quality.

Don't get the 7 course meal. It's just a waste of time and food IMO. My go to is the LAMB kabobs or steak kabobs. Soooooo good. Very flavorful and the rice pilaf is just *french kiss*. The place looks basic on the outside but the inside is amazing. Decorated perfectly, you will feel the vibes indeed. The hookah area is small but it's very chill for a night out with friends. Drink prices are great and lots of hookah flavors. This is a great date night spot.

This place is a diamond in the rough! Great food EVERY TIME. Thanks for the great service too merry Christmas!
BC
I couldn't even walk in the music was soooo load not enjoyable...and I like my music turned up

Great spot for a work luncheon!  The salads are enormous and would convert even the meat and potatoes guy to love a good salad.  Meatball subs, wings and toasted ravioli is so good too.  We always grab a lunch portion and end up bringing a ton home!  Such a hidden gem!!!
The food is even better than it was at Pho 36. The staff is fantastic and remembered my usual from 5 years ago! Definitely check them out
The best place in New Orleans by far. The fish was cooke Sri perfection, their service impeccable, and the atmosphere is everything you would want for a nice quiet dinner out.

Amazing and Extremely Customer Focused with Great Food. I truly cannot day enough about how well the staff, and especially Pat and Roger did for us the other day for our banquet. It was a funeral luncheon, and every single employees wished us condolences for our loss. Everyone was extremely friendly always asking "What else do you need," or "Can we get you anything?"

The food was premium with amazing taste and temperature and there was plenty of it. While the food was great, the customer service was far and away some of the best I have ever experienced. The price was beyond reasonable and my family and I could tell it was far more important to the staff that our experience was positive and that we were taken care of than anything else. 

You have a customer for life and while it was a difficult day, our experience at Anthony's was incredibly special. I truly hope Pat and Roger get recognized for their exemplary performance and attention to the customers, even though we all felt more like family than customers. Thank You Anthony's and I'm looking forward to coming back for dinner with my family soon!
Best pizza in the area! They have the best by the slice selections and the best Italian desserts too. Pizza's come by the slice, large 16" , or extra large 18" sizes.
Always a fabulous dining experience. The staff is delightful and the food is delicious.

Tried this spot for lunch with a friend today.  First off, I have a pretty decent intolerance to gluten, but have an even larger love of all things gluten! So I was totally down when she suggested Campos.  Lucky for me they had a gluten free crust pizza! Gluten free crusts are always hit or miss, and I'll say theirs was a hit! The pizza was delicious! Their bloody Mary's were really good as well! The server was nice, quick and efficient. I would definitely go again!

Start saying the service was great. Restaurant was clean.
The food wasn't.
No sweet tea.. only added sweater.
So went with soft drink.
I ordered the brisket with fries.
The brisket had no taste only a sauce they coated it with that made it taste like sauce-berry steak.
The fries were ok but could've used added salt for flavor.
My wife got the tenderloin and fries.
The tenderloin was covered in mustard?
We both managed to eat the food we paid for but as return guest I will pass.
To each their own.
Pizza206 never disappoints!  Their wings and pizza are always cooked perfectly and are delicious. We generally get takeout here at least once a week and have no plans on stopping anytime soon!

I was having lunch at this restaurant today. The food was fine BUT one of the line workers - a young man- started yelling  and being incrEdibly disrespectful to a Door Dash delivery person who I watched wait for at least 1/2 hour. The delivery  man asked a question about the order to another employee and the Garbanzo guy started in on him from way down the line. I and my lunch companion and all those around us were appalled. I may like the food but thE atmosphere was uncomfortable and rude. Given the disrespect towards delivery service which I have used, I will pick other restaurants.

The Grandma-Style soup was good-ish, I just wish the fresh veggies were a bit more tender and that the broth had more salt. In addition, I had purchased the challah turkey slider sandwich. The bread itself was super dry and almost tasted stale and the lettuce was brown in spots. Super underwhelming considering that little slider is $5. The best part of the meal was the chocolate chip cookie. SO BOMB. The customer service was also pretty good.

EDIT: I just remembered that there was no celery or fresh herbs in my soup whereas I see it in the photos on here. Ah well. ‍

The was the same still good I guess, and also I like the fact that they have throwaway menus. I think that really good for the times now. I would say 80% of the menu is on it which is not bad at all!!!

Claim jumper is now a complete family restaurant with its new prime steak menu. The Chilean sea bass is butter soft and the capers are just the right garnish. You can get any thing from a kids chicken tender meal to a 37oz tomahawk steak meant for "two" lol unless you're brave enough and always cooked the way you like. The tables are clean, the music is great (but unfortunately no karaoke, sad face), and all the friendly faces you could expect all while wearing a mask of course. 

My personal favorite even though there are so many to choose from are the new prime bone in ribeye with the also new truffle fries

Two years ago I came in Friday night and I completely switched my views. I had a negative opinion about this restaurant but I just came in this last Friday night with my husband for a second time and complete360. Vanessa was the best bartender I have seen in Reno. This will be my new place as a gambler. Thank you again! I told the manager about my experience 2 years ago and he tried everything to make it right and he succeeded because of him and Vanessa this will he my husbands and Is new place! See you Friday! Thank you Rob and Vanessa
Very good food!! I've been craving some smokey bones lately! I love the mac and cheese and your loaded nachos, and fried pickles! Yumm!

Came here for lunch during work, did not like hearing from the bartender HEATHER, to the other bartender, to take our drink orders because she was not going to make them. Very unprofessional service, kept giving dirty looks the entire time I was trying to enjoy lunch & a drink with a friend. Highly suggest she is taken off the bar because it is also not the first time this bartender gives us a problem at the winghouse, and we love coming to the winghouse.

Nothing special. Drove over 30 minutes because a friend hyped this place up. Ordered the ruebenettes. Lunchmeat overly salty and wayyy too much grease. So much grease I could not pick up my sandwich because the bottom piece of bread was soaked in grease. The grease also tasted a little old. Needs to be changed. It was at best... Okay. Service is very very verrrrrrrrrrrrrry slow. Took near 40 minutes for our tables order to come out.  It was also very warm. Huge fan just whipping hot air from the outside around. The decor was pretty on point. I like the concept but they have a lot to work on. The food needs to be served fresh. Service honestly could be more friendly, more inviting.. So that at least the wait for your food isn't so bad. Turn the a/c on and close the doors. Its lovebug season and hot as hell, closed doors are desired. Wish them the best of luck.

If you're afraid of Covid, this is not the place for you. When we showed up place was packed to the brim and not a mask in sight with people walking around except the staff. The food was good. The wings were amazing and I would highly recommend.

My honest opinion, the place is overrated, I know some natives to New Orleans might disagree. 

Dirty tables and the Bignets are very doughy, but Cafe au lait is fantastic.

Check out the location in the French quarter "for the experience"
Cool atmosphere with games that kids can play, (pool, air hockey, pop o shot & video games) nicer staff and good service. Food is more normal bar food and nothing special.

Ordering is a little difficult as the menu hangs above the register so lots of pressure to decide what you want if you haven't been before. I got the roast beef on a croissant and it has melted cheddar cheese but honestly you should get it with cheese sauce so it isn't as dry. They have a few beers on tap and lots of variety when it comes to burgers, sandwiches, and hot dogs. Neat to try at least once but I'm not in a rush to go back.
Doesn't look like much from ther outside but it is a nice clean diner inside with bei friendly staff. Breakfast was good and mimosas were only $2.99.

Food was fine, but I highly recommend ordering online and waiting line 30 minutes... AFTER they say it'll be ready!  I got there was they said it would be ready and I was legit standing there for 35 f-ing minutes! Staff didn't even seem to give a damn, they were just carelessly walking around and talking taking their sweet ass time and gave zero f@cks that me and 3 other people had been waiting so long. I could've driven to the one in Tampa and been back before I got my food

This place rocks! The pizza, the staff, all of it! I love the garlic butter they put on the breadsticks and their pizza sauce is my new obsession. (I pass up my usual nacho cheese dipping sauce for some extra marinara for the sticks.) Every time we've gone, even on a busy Friday night, the staff has been efficient and very attentive. They run like a well oiled machine! Their team really makes an effort to make you feel welcomed. Top notch food and customer service. I highly recommend.
Service was great, food was fresh and very tasty. The staff was helpful in my menu selection and I wasn't disappointed.  Jackfruit was transformed into a delicious meal.

I am sorry but the service is just terrible they take a half and hour in line for me just to get two milkshakes it is just outrageous and i do not recommend this place to anyone unless you have a lot of time to waste!!!!

Excellent addition to the Tucson Middle Eastern food scene ( and we've tried them all) !!! delicious food, lovingly served, huge portions, some unique Egyptian choices.   Beautiful wall murals in a cozy setting .  Try it !  You'll love it!!

I've been to this location several times as I live close, and order from my office as well for staff events. However, I want to give a special shout out to this location on keeping up amazing work during the COVID-19 pandemic. I ordered lunch for one (besto pesto quesadilla, sweet potato fries), and was given enough for three people. Their quesadillas are LOADED with chicken when you add it in. Quality is not suffering right now. Everything ordered was ready exactly on time. One of my favorite places in the area for any type of food/beverage.
Overall the food was pretty good .... but guys, the chips and guacamole was $15.00 .... what in the actual eff? Those avocados must have been made outta gold. FIFTEEN?!

Their veggie plate is fo die for. I travel across town to eat their great food. It's a small business & family oriented. 

Today was a slow day (very surprised) they're usually super busy. Since we're regulars, they know what I'm ordering before I approach the counter. 

Thanks for the great service & great food. I'm looking forward to visiting next month :-)

The website states their hours as being 11 to 9, 7 days a week. However, a google search and using apple maps shows their closing time as 11-10 on Fri-Sat. When I called to order at 8:40 somebody answered and said they were closing. I'm just letting the staff here know that theres an inaccuracy in what schedules the internet pulls up. I still get four stars because I love the food but its disappointing to call, expecting them to still be open and then be told they're closed.

This place is super yummy and in a great location right on the water. We ordered the oysters to start and I ordered the shrimp gulf Blvd tacos which were both delicious. The food was very flavorful and the wait-staff were super friendly and welcoming! Highly recommend this place for good food and a great atmosphere!

This McDonalds location always tells me their ice cream machine is "down" and it's quite hard to believe a chain fast food restaurant doesn't immediately get someone to fix it when it's one of the most popular things people order.

Was really looking forward to trying this place for a birthday celebration.  Had a reservation for 6 people and at the last minute had to change it to 7 people.  At first I thought I'd just show up and they could add another chair at the table.  But then I that what the heck, I'll just call so it makes it easier.  Sooooo, not only did the woman that answered the phone have a rude demeanor, but guess what, they couldn't add another person.  Let me say that again....they couldn't add 1 more person to a party of 6.  One would think that a new restaurant would want to be particularly cordial to people looking to dine in their establishment, but you would also think they would say no problem to add 1 more person.  I have never in my life had a restaurant prefer to lose a party of 6 over making it a party of 7.   Unfortunately they won't be on my short list of places to go any time soon in Carmel.  Plenty of other places that will eagerly accommodate a small change in a reservation.
One of the better cheesesteaks in and out of the Philadelphia area.  Beats Geno's and Pats hand down. Don't pass this up when in the mood.

Great tavern atmosphere. Two of the 3 stars are for atmosphere. Unfortunately the food was only 1 star.   Dont order pulled pork sandwich or the tavern ham.  Both were way too salty.   Tavern ham was a pile of lunchmeat instead of the expected sliced ham. Prices were way too much for a tavern.   We told the server about the salty pulled pork which my left more than half on the plate.  Still got charged for it.  Will be a long time before returning.
Good food, big portions but sometimes a long wait but worth it!  It's set up with retro 50's decor.
This looks like a typical strip mall Japanese establishment. It is, but they offer quite a value for the price and quality. I typically get their 3 roll special which is ample food and quite filling.

Happen to drive by looking for a place to eat and happen to find this gem! Small quaint venue...we sat by the window. Probably not the best spot coz there was a slew of pick up orders. Other than that, atmosphere was pleasant, cool jazz music,  and excellent menu selection. Service was great..now lets touch on the FOOD! Their special appetizer - Snowbird dumplings was out of this world. A mix of spicy inside covered with a pasta like shaped like a bird exterior, with option for spicy sauce dip. The currys was our choice and was so yummy and authentic.  We are definitely going back!!

Looking for a nearby gem with no wait and my brother found this place on Yelp. So happy he did! We loved the ecclectic decor and the super friendly/funny staff. Loud enough inside to take a 1 year old and not have to worry if he made sounds. The food was delicious! Everyone ordered something different and we all shared a little, not one bad thing ordered!

I have lived just down the street from this Coffee Shop for past year and I have to say it is undoubtably our go to. The staff is friendly and attentive, and I have yet to have anything less than excellent from the kitchen. The upstairs dine in area is a little small and might be difficult for large groups, but we've had a great experience here and the BYOB breakfast option is a plus.

Thanks Yelpers, a great find in Goleta. We were passing thru on the way to LA. Looking for sandwiches and poof, 5 star. We had three Chipotle Chicken sandwiches and 2 chicken soft tacos. Fair prices, very tasty food, super fresh. 

Called in my order direct, ready on time and fast checkout.
Every time I go there is has been delicious! I've become obsessed with the Mexico roll it's my new fav

This Wawa is surprisingly awful. Not surprising that it's awful, but surprisingly in how bad it is. The instant coffee machine thing was out of commission... but that also meant no hot water to make tea. I assumed there must be a tap on a coffee maker behind the counter, but no. So, I went for some brewed coffee instead. Poured some... and noticed zero feeling of warmth in my hand. I stuck my finger in, it was ice cold. Excellent. The whole coffee service area was a hot (or, not hot) mess- used cups, wrappers, stirrers, etc everywhere. 

A dude was walking around and waiting for an order with no mask on. Not even "pretend to care" with it hanging under his nose- he had no mask in sight. 

After I got my food- which they inexplicably doubled, gave me two sammiches- I went to get gas. First pump I go to has an error message on the screen, something about "security check in progress." Ive never seen one of those before... and I had to get back in my car, and circle around for a pump with no error message. 

The icing on the cake is that, as my gas was pumping, I watched someone in their parked car- no more than a few dozen feet from at least 20 trash cans- drop trash out their door on to the ground. Zero shame.
This place is great! There was a bit of a wait but the seafood was fresh even at the late hour and the service was great
Awesome pizza!  Had this delivered for a large group.  It was a busy night for them but they delivered hot and yummy pizza!  Next time we are in town this will be a must have!!

Been going here periodically for 30 years, but was extremely disappointed with last order. Asked for a gluten free cheesesteak with no roll. Found chunks of bread and breaded pieces off of some sort or fried item in with the cheesesteak. Luckily saw before I ate the item and threw it out. So beware if you have any allergys and eat here. There is no attempt to be allergen friendly, the staff should be educated on celiac disease.

Food was good. Got the crab stuffed chicken breast which was very tasty. However, the servers definitely made us feel out of place being the only  Americans dressed casually there although I don't think the server realized it. Subconscious bias? I hope in the future to be treated as well as Caucasian guests.
We go here at least once a week! Great food and service!! We have even used them for catering for my business.
Damn! What can I say? This place is phenomenal! We always sit at the bar, but table service is great too. We go all over but this is a place we always come back to.

Delicious this place is a must try

However last time I ordered I was missIng my appetizer and my dessert which was such a let down. When I calLed to be refunded the person on the phone was kind of rude and said they wouldn't refund me. I honestly just wanted my items I had already bough, not my money back. So that sucked but the food is Awesome!
Their guacamole and chips are to die for. Love the veggie burrito and the tacos . Definitely worth trying out.

We hit up Hugh Baby's on Friday evening and could not write enough good things about our experience.

Ordering was quick and easy, and staff was friendly to help with out (somewhat) picky child. The burgers came out quick and were the perfect size. I could defined put 2 or 3 of them down on a good day, but my burger & fries were just the right amount.  My wife had the cheeseburger with everything on it, and she's still talking about how good it was four days later. I went with the mushroom & swiss burger, and again was the perfect ratio of toppings to meat. Our son enjoyed his plain cheeseburger & chocolate shake. 

The seating area is really a cool setting, especially on this cool Friday evening as they had the garage door open to the outdoor seating area. Made of a nice environment and just an overall enjoyable experience.

Can't wait to make it back for trip #2.
Food was delicious, drinks were great and service was awesome! Will, Ashley and Jessica really took care of us!

The ole lady and I came here about a week ago...  The last time I was here was shortly after they opened (I believe dat was back in 2014-ish..)

So it had been a while.

Presentation was really good.  They are practicing 'Rona free measures, which is also good... but my ole lady and I both agreed that the meat products were too salty..

She had the turkey sandwich, I had the burger.  Both very salty.  Almost unfinishable.

The food was absolutely delicious. We had to use the curbside pick up that worked out just fine, and our food was still hot when we got home. We will definitely be going back and hopefully be eating inside.

I'm sorry to have to take two stars from this place. Maybe it was a bad night.  I went with a large party again and it was just pretty subpar from the start. They were not super busy for a Friday night but our server seemed rushed. ( I think he had tables inside and outside).  Ok I get it. However he was simply curt and cold.  No discussion about the menu no suggestions for drinks . This guy did not speak unless we flagged him down . I can honestly say we felt like unwanted quests and I don't just throw that out there.  Anyway on to the food 
We started with the calamari . It was in a tomato sauce which not only made it cold but also soggy 
We also had the mac and cheese. This was the saving grace. Had it not been for the slightly burned topping this would have been perfect. 

Most of us ordered their signature garlic chicken . It was in desperate need of some salt but it was a large portion and tasty

There was a carbonara dish at the table which she said she enjoyed and a side salad

I remember the gluten free bread being delicious in the past and waited patiently for it to appear . An hour into our visit I finally asked for it. It wasn't as good as I remembered it . 

Deserts were chocolate torte which was like the most bitter dry slice of chalk you could imagine and bread pudding. Now THIS!!! Honey  I will come back just for the bread pudding . It was crisp around edges, warm in middle and had a caramel sauce to die for.

I found myself stuck waiting for a delayed flight to come in.  Hotel staff directed me to a Denny's but it was closed so ended up here.  
It's been probably 25 years since I've been to a Cracker Barrel.  I did have to wait (maybe because Denny's was closed, more pressure here).  I didn't like having to wait in a "store".  I don't remember that from previous visit. 
The selection of foods was great and I was able to find all the comfort food I desired on this cold, fall day.  Service was good and I loved the huge fire in the fireplace - it added to the homey feel.

Came here right on the last day before they close till March with a couple of friends. The staff was friendly and the outdoor dining was reasonably distanced.

The House Smoked Eggs Benedict was pretty decent. The eggs were poached well. According to the waiter the salmon is wet smoked , but it lacks the flavor to not be overpowered by the hollandaise sauce. The hollandaise sauce itself was way too buttery for me. The first thing you taste is butter assaulting yourself tastebuds and it drowns everything else out. 

Overall it wasn't a bad meal, a bit higher priced then what I would like for the flavors I got. It would have been better if they redid the hollandaise and giving salmon having more flavor.

I wanted to get something familiar so I stopped by for a bite.  I was met by the bartender right away.  She asked me if I would be eating or just drinking   I really wantEd too just drink after a long day but knew that I needed to eat so I ordered my usual when I go to chili's which is the soup and salad.  Nothing fancy but consistent across most chili's. That's all the boring stuff.  Now the bartender Labreal, was quite amazing.  She didn't let my glass get below 1/4 before asking me what I would  like next.  I'm kinda weird where I will jump all over the place when drrinking so I started with a wine, switched to grayHound, then whiskey diet and finally a screw driver.  Labreal kept up and made all the drinks very well and the conversation was great.  It  was such a great experience to  have the excellent service. The other patrons were really fun too.  Although this is a chain restaurant, it has a very good atmosphere, the locals are  fun and not a stand offish.  And again, you need to come by and just see what great service and supreme bartending provided by a very friendly Labreal!  You won't be dis disappointed.

What was once the best Mexican restaurant in Brandon has gone way way downhill!!!  Chips used to be GREAT but now are very bland and their Salsa Sauce seems very watered down!   Also use to offer COUPONS which have been long gone!  Go back to your food-n-service from a year ago and you may be able to recover. What happened to your  place???
We ordered a family meal of charred chicken and one steak bowl. The charred chicken was good and delicious but it really felt like cooked rather than grilled.  The steak bowl was ok.

The service was not just bad, it was the worst. App order for a sandwich. Gave me the wrong sandwich. I then verbally gave them my sandwich order and they still got it wrong again! I understand times are tough for restaurants right now, but to get a sandwich order wrong by app order and in person? They didn't seem to care about the mistake either, as I was offered no refund or discount for a future order. Very disappointing how Newk's turned out here. I figured when Newk's came in it would give the McCalisters a run, but McCalisters will get all my business now in the area.

Excellent burgers, fries, and fried pickles! My husband and I are visiting from out out town and happened upon this little burger joint. Delicious food and great customer service. When we showed up no one was there (it was also 5:15pm on a Friday night ) but by the time we left the place was packed. Grab it early! Amazing homemade ranch for the pickles as well!

We eat here all the time.  Then our last time we order we were given incorrect and burnt pizza.  Called and asked for them to fix it.  We would even take the uneaten, inedible, pizzas back.  The staff answering the phone was very nice.  The owner came on the phone and was very rude and told us they would not be fixing it.

Well. What can I say but not good. Went in, you follow the assembly line, no problem. You order one thing and the family in front of you orders six or seven. You wait. Can only do one thing at a time. So I I ordered a king po chicken bowl. A far cry from what you would get in any formal Chinese restaurant. Just junk all fat!

Best chicken sandwich ever. Popeye's who?! The honey chicken sandwich with a fried egg is my go to and it never fails. The chicken is always hot and crispy, the caramelized honey is a delicious touch and the fried egg seals the deal. They have a bunch of different variations but I have yet to try anything else bc the honey chicken is THAT good. Do yourself a favor and try it out

Good food for a fair price. Staff was friendly and attentive. Ate here on Sunday morning so there is a wait,  but they will text you when your table is ready if you want to walk around while waiting. Food was fresh and tasty. Monterey Omelette was very good and not too heavy. Menu has some traditional southern dishes as well (I.e. chicken and waffles). Would visit this place again.

Maybe the other locations are better, but we went to the location that's been there 100+ years. I know it's an old building, but it was severely unhygienic. The bathrooms were disgusting, liquid which I Hope was water in the ground but who knows it's New Orleans and maybe another guy peed on the ground? Powder everywhere on the floor. The only thing I liked was that the food and coffee was cheap unlike everything else in the area. Try another location, or another cafe if you must

Yesterday my family and I ordered some food but when we received it the all the fries were burnt so this afternoon I contacted the store manager her name is Dorothy she was so helpful and sound sincere, she just didn't say sorry but she fixed and the store delivered our food hot! Delicious!!! I would recommend this restaurant to anyone that loves BBQ and wonderful service come to Fat Jack's BBQ!

My go to spot for my lunch break durning work or to grab a juice / smoothie after a yoga session! Delicious, fresh food that is always made to order, not to mention being able to customize any salad, wrap, or smoothie is so convenient and helpful to people with food allergies and/or anyone who is on a strict diet. I come here at least 3x a week! I love the friendly staff as well! Drive thru is also a plus for those lazy days ha ha ;)
Our favorite go-to place for quality breakfast! The food is consistently good! The biscuits and gravy are the best! Get there early on the weekend otherwise expect a wait.

Excited to see another Hawaiian-inspired poke spot in town.

Grabbed a bowl to go for lunch on Thursday.  I intentionally went early (11:20) to beat the lunch rush, which was smart because there was barely a wait. 

Service was decent -- about what one can expect at a quick-service restaurant.  The woman making my bowl was friendly.  I ordered a large (4-scoop) Spicy Tuna bowl with brown rice.  Additional toppings were no charge; I added seaweed salad and Kim Chi radish.  The serving size was good and the ingredients seemed fresh, but I found the bowl to be overall quite bland.  The spicy sauce completely lacked flavor and heat; I had to add some Sriracha to really taste anything. 

There is some, but not much, seating.  The interior of the restaurant is simple.  They had a big-screen TV showing surfing in Maui, and it sounded like reggae/island music was playing.  Nice touches, but  otherwise not much character. 

Hawaiian Sun juice for purchase, but only one flavor.  Would love to see more variety.  A couple other beverages available as well.

A colleague tried the shrimp bowl, and did not really like it.  He found the shrimp to be undercooked.

Not terrible, but not great.  Remember, I'm from Hawaii, so I am a tough poke critic!  But I have definitely had better out here.  Either way, I am open to trying it again.

I have been coming to this restaurant for many years and the last time I was there was on a Sunday I believe it was the 7th of March for brunch. We had a table of five. As always we have great service, excellent food. But one thing that really amazed me and I really said to myself that is an outstanding, over the top and went over what most people would do. The manager that runs the store. I did not know his name but he's tall, big guy, wearing all black, stands by the food that comes out to be delivered and makes sure everything is high quality I'm sure. He has reddish blond hair I believe. Well I asked to have jelly with my sour toast and I did not know they either ran out or did not have this, but he decided to go at publix and pick up some mini jams so that I would have that for my toast. When I found out that he was doing this he had already left and I was going to tell them that is silly to do that, that I am ok without it. But as soon as I said that he was back,. and handed me two mini jams. That to me is a manager who cares about his customers. 

PS Please bring back the stuffed shrimp!

The security manager is a joke. He should probably get over his power trip and worry about actual underage drinkers rather than a 28 year old with a valid ID. He tried to make someone provide Facebook pictures as proof of ID after a 2nd photo ID was shown and still would not let this person in based on his power trip. Earlier in the night we were drinking at MacDintons with no problems, so after the ridiculous measures we went through trying to go to yard of ale (which mind you we drink there frequently) we later went back to Macdintons and went through security with no problems again. After ordering our drinks and doing nothing wrong this tool comes in to MacDintons and kicks us out based on the fact that "we needed to provide valid ID which we did. At 28 who tries to use a fake ID? There are real problems this guy should focus on rather than kicking out adults who have not done anything wrong. This guy needs to be fired because we were completely disrespected. There needs to better a better security system in place to verify IDs. Also, Facebook is not a "valid form of identification".

The atmosphere is nice with the beach in walking distance. The live music was great! The bar was packed upon arrival. We found a seat at the bar. Ended up getting the money business bucket drink. It was decent. Nothing to write home about.

I went here with my boyfriend who was looking for a good place to get gyros. I personally am not a big fan of gyros myself so opted for the chicken shawarma wrap which looked amazing. However, when we got home and opened our boxes to my surprise there was not a chicken shawarma wrap but rather a second gyro. I probably shouldn't have been surprised by this because the guy who took our order didn't seem to a) be listening nor b) care about it. I noticed that there & made sure our order was correct by getting the recipient - Theref my first time here was pretty disappointing BUT my boyfriend loved the gyro stating it was one of the "best" he's had. Sooo we will definitely be going back & I'll be sure to check the box before leaving so I can finally try the chicken shawarma wrap!


- CHANGED TO 5 STARS BC WHEN I CAME BACK TO TRY AGAIN THEY REIMBURSED ME FOR THE MISTAKE

This had to be the absolute slowest Chick-Fil-A on the entire planet!

The food was exactly what I ordered and the service was "polite" it was just slow.
Great food and great service!  Cheesesteaks are excellent and bay fries with American cheese sauce are delicious!

Amazing cant beat this quality at this price.
I had the egg benedict here and it came out fast. 
Service was great. I dont think you can beat the quality at this price point. And the lunch and dinner special menu is insane. I honestly think it is a bit too much food for the price.

Chef Evelyn is the greatest chef in the world!! Omg those flavors!!  Where do they even come from and how can she make them so perfectly sweet and spicy and rich and yummy all at the same time!??

I tried her food one day at politan row (I'm a very picky eater and never adventurous) and I haven't been able to shake the incredible taste combinations!! Oh my word.  There's nothing else quite like it and it's all sooooo delicious. 

I highly recommend the cucumber salad, roti wrap, and the curry. The seaweed rice is also so delicious (not the kind of rice you make at home) with the curry and pretty much anything else she comes up with is a YES for me. 

I like to order extra curry and save it for the next day because it lasts perfectly. 

Chef Evelyn-- Thank you so much for providing such amazing food and staying open during these tough times. 

To everyone else-- go get some of her amazing takeout!!! You won't regret it.

Very adorable cafe. I love the atmosphere, so calm and comfy. The food is delicious and well priced. Coffee is wonderful. It can get very busy during the weekend, so if you want a more chill vibe, definitely head over during the week. A good selection of pastries, delicious soups. Can't go wrong here.

4 star for authenticity but no AC in the whole restaurant in the Florida heat weather

First thought walking into the restaurant was - wow feels like I'm in Vietnam, so authentic. Second thought - wow it's pretty hot in here. 

This past weekend in Tampa was around 95-98 degrees and boy it was HOT! I walked in and I immediately got very sweaty from all the pho around me beaming with steam.

I got a strawberry boba over ice and it was very refreshing with lots of flavor! It was great having something cold in the restaurant when there was no AC (they had like 8 fans going off but it wasn't enough for me)

And I also got some spring rolls, nice big shrimps inside with fresh noodles and lettuce. Pretty refreshing and the sauce was as authentic as it can get! 

I will come back when the weather is cooler for some pho but overall fairly good food and true to its culture!

I should frequent this place way more since I live so close. It's the perfect mix of a quick breakfast favorite(bagel) and everything you want on sandwich. This time I had to Indy 500, but I subbed turkey for ham since I don't eat pork. I also got a wheat bagel instead of a white bagel. Lastly, I added chipotle mayo because I thought it would Accent the jalapeños.The bagels are always so fresh and hot. You have to let them cool down for at least 3 minutes or you'll burn the roof of your mouth. I will be going back again soon.

WOW what can I say but WOW !
Been here in Reno for a couple of days but visit often.
I'm not a big fan of their food but tried it out today since it was in GSR.
Superb customer service - unlike some dry by servers we've experienced over the last few months coming to Reno at many other establishments.
Tina provided services as if it was fine dining ! Other staff members were gooacknowledged us as we walked in.
Thanked Mgr Robert for taking his time to come and speak with us about our experience with their good food and service !

Small little place, counter ordering.  Thought i would check it out.  Limited options but i like that, specialization.

Chicken Shawarma sand platter with garlic sauce and hummus sauce, because I'm not a fan of cucumbers.....chicken was rather bland as was the entire sandwich, it was dry, not fresh of the meet cooking on the spit....it was a Monday so sometimes that means left over product from weekend, it tasted as such.  Would like to see the meat cut off what is cooking, that's why its there...prolly wont return, i know of other optiins i enjoy for this cuisine.
One of the best Mexican restaurant I ever been, with great service  and delicious food,, I highly recommended

Oh man what a disappointment. After two bites, I threw this cardboard sandwich away and bought a real one from firehouse subs down the street. 
Save yourself the time and don't go here

Small buffet and decent food! Buffet is usually $11.99 but I caught it on special for only $7.50 the night that I went. My favorite dish was the tandoori chicken and their samosas are exceptionally good. The man who waited us was very kind.

5 Stars = Service
5 Stars = Food
I ordered the crawfish pasta with a fillet on top.  The fish was seasoned too perfection and fried right,  not to hard or soft.  The pasta sauce was a heavy whipping cream/cheese sauce blend with a few spices and very flavorful. 

My husband ordered the shrimp and fish Po Boy and he enjoyed it.  He mentioned bread was very soft. 

Tarter sauce is good! Food came fast. 

Highly recommend this spot if looking for some good catfish!

Donuts were nothing to say hey go to this place good effort. Staff friendly and super helpful the reason for rating just solely based on not a fan of these donuts will not be going back. I also tried the danishes and there was to much jelly in the middle and not set well. Those danishes the jam came out in a glob seemed like it was placed as an after thought.The Christmas jam in the store portion definitely amazing.

We loved this place. 
Great food & great service.
Spinach omelet was outstanding and highly recommend the biscuits/beignets!

If your in the downtown Nashville area, this is the perfect breakfast joint. 
We were ere before 9am so we were seated immediately. It can get fairly backed up once everyone wakes up from late night excursions.

I've been wanting to try Indo for a long time and I was so happy I've been able to stop by for takeout during quarantine. The pickup experience was really easy and the food did not disappoint! I ordered the short rib khao soi which was so full of flavor! The tenderness of the short rib and the complexity of the curry was so delicious. There's so many things on the menu I'm wanting to try. Will definitely be back soon!

The quality of the fish was not questionable, nor was the service. The building itself was small but clean and cozy. My only alms against this establishment is the lack luster presentation and the half assed construction of the sushi rolls. It's not a sushi roll if only half the roll is covered completely in rice and half the roll has come undone. Also the rice on the roll itself was hard. Sushi Station may want to reconsider the way their sushi rice is prepared and stored to avoid dry and hard rice, as well as making sure their sushi chefs are capable or properly making uramaki rolls. But the wait staff was extremely attentive, suggestive and caring. I'd suggest going here if you were more concerned about the hospitality over the quality of the sushi.
Excellent food and service! Lots of food for a little price! If ever  in Zephyrhills, stop by and give it it a try! We will certainly be returning again to check out  more things on the menu!

This place is so cool! The patio area has sections that seclude you and have TVs in each. With the current pandemic it's a perfect way to stay distanced from other groups. Good atmosphere and friendly staff. We'll definitely be back for game days.
We go here all the time. Food is amazing and great people. Definitely recommend to all around to give this a shot. The Kernel is the best!!

We got some take out from Fiesta Maya. The burritos were solid.

In the burrito, they give you a choice of main ingredient (veggies or meats), rice, beans, and 3 add-ons which are included. There's also salsa to go with the side of tortilla chips (included with the burrito).

We tried burritos with Chicken al pastor & Mayan Pork. The chicken didn't seem to have much flavour, but the burrito was still generally good. 

Good clean tasty ingredients.
Reasonable prices.

Family owned and operated and it shows!! They care about quality!  Never had a bad meal or even a "so so" meal. Everything is outstanding. My family of 6 adults, who are "foodies", literally moan with delight while taking their first bite of their entre!  We drive 20 minutes to get take-out from Tres Yan & Wu when there are dozens of Asian restaurants that are closer!  Meats are tender, not over-cooked, re-heated, tough and dry like other places we've tried. Vegetables are also cooked to perfection. Also no fatty chunks, sinew or cartilage in meats (a problem often with other places)  Everything is flavorful and portions are large.  Our must-haves are Grandfathers Chicken, Mu Shu Pork, Pad Thai and Lo Mein. Whatever you order, you will be happy!

One of my favorite St. Louis restaurants. The food is amazing and I just love a well run small and quiet restaurant. This is a great place to have a good meal and good conversation with clients or good friends.

This place was mediocre. So many better places to be tried then this in Nashville. They don't have a specialty item. When we asked our waiter what was the best thing on the menu they said the cheeseburger. My friend ordered it and it was nothing special. Wish we went somewhere else.

Sadly we were very disappointed here. Heard the cream of chicken rice soup was great. It was bland. My husband ordered broiler flounder with lemon butter sauce. It came on the side and the flounder was dried out. He sent it back but was charged for the salad and soup andcoffee I had crab cakes. Very little crab in them. Dessert was to come with my meal. Never did  He was overcharged for the salad and soup and coffee that was a part of the meal he sent back. At the register he was given a very hard time. We won't be back

This was a glorious success.  Everything is homemade, clearly made with love and pride.  This owner himself is the head chef and came to the table to have a chat and make sure we were happy (we were ridiculously happy, spoiler alert. My husband loved his lamb.  My falalafel was amazing and moist inside, and my daughter's chicken souvlaki was delicious.  You've got to get the appetizer platter with the best homemade pita I've ever had, anywhere.  It was pillowy with crisp, buttery edges and spiced delicately with some amazingness that I can't describe, but will probably dream about tonight.  I also left my credit card, and the owner came running out to give it back.  It was such a lovely, homey meal.  We felt like family, and not just patrons.  Can't wait to go back and try even more of the menu!

Horrible service!!! Good food, jambalaya and craole was good but way overpriced! We never got our drinks which we asked for and the waitress never came around, in fact..another waitress had to check on our status..

2 of us got the Tuna poke wantons which was very good, better then I thought. Wife had the steak portobello quesadilla & they were awesome as well. We also got a picture of margarita that was pretty good. Chips were very small & cracked, like the bottom of the bags chips. Good atmosphere & seems good for kids.

My son and I have been on "the best lobster roll in town hunt" so this was our contestant number 3. So we decided to day trip to Santa Barbara and our first stop was the Santa Barbara Mission which is a must see by the way, but came right after to the Shellfish Company which is right off the dock of the pier. Many social distancing areas to feel at ease with a little crowd. Service was fast, within 10-15 minutes of our order. Perfect for a bite and site seeing for a while. The lobster roll was missing the big bang we looked for. The roll could have been a little more moist, less crunchy. Would have liked a nice side to compliment the lobster...a onion ring or two doesn't make the masterpiece. What about a nice roasted corn salad or maybe sweet potato fries to give some tang to the plate? The bread bowl for my chowder was also a little hard to dip with. Maybe it just needed a little more time in the oven. Overall, great lobster.
The #RibBloom. Let your onion bloom. Absolutely delicious. Also, the coconut shrimp is Ah'maz'ing! #Jenkintown #Pa #Outback
The buffalo wings were great!! The tomato pie was ok. We can't wait to go back to try a few of the other things on the menu.

Found this place on a whim trying to find food that was open after 2. They had so many food options I was so happy because I was starving, so it all hit the spot!! We ordered mozzarella sticks, Mac and cheese bites, fried pickles, and garlic fries, all so tasty and just what we needed after a night on bourbon!!

Great service great staff and too notch food and Guinness.

As an Irishman this has one of the best and freshest pints stateside. Almost as good as back in Dublin lol.

If you haven't been this is a great experience. Live music is also great.
Great barbecue and awesome potato salad and baked beans and great pulled pork sandwiches. Eat here you won't be disappointed. Great prices as well
Had to stop by for a slice of cake on Valentine's Day. It's such a treat and I love how warm and friendly the staff is here.

The best Mexican food I've had in Nashville! I would eat there everyday if I lived in the neighborhood.

Ok I don't live in the neighborhood but I eat here sometimes 2 or 3 times a week! Amazing!

We called in our order for curbside service because the on-line order site was not working.  I placed my order at 4:45 and asked they have it ready by 5:30.  We arrived to pick up at 5:30 and were told they would bring it out as soon as it was ready.  At 6:00 they finally came out.  The food was cold and they forgot one of the sides.  I commented to the server that we were very disappointed with our experience explaining the delay and the cold food.  She offered to have a manager come out and maybe they could reheat the food.  Really? Wait another half hour for reheated food?
We will not be visiting BJ's again anytime soon.

This place would be great if they have taco Tuesdays! Other than that, Little bit pricey compared to others or legit Mexican food store in the shady areas lol tastes is good, i would be back time to time but $4 per taco is too much.

Took my family there last night for our "fancy" dinner while on vacation in Nashville. We made reservations, the day before online. We were greeted by a very nice person, promptly sat at our table. Service was outstanding all night, didn't hover but were always there when needed. Everyone ordered steaks, ribeyes and fillets, all were prepared as ordered and very good. Quality of meat was excellent, sides were all very good and portions were plentiful. We managed to save room for desert, white chocolate cheesecake was awesome as was the Creme Brûlée. Overall highly recommend this place, excellent food and service and cost was around $65 per person.
Having dinner with my honey at the Patriots Crossing Tavern. The food,drinks, and service are great!!! Our server is Dee ask for her!!! Trust me...

This kills me to have to write this review, but hopefully it will get through to someone.  
My mom was visiting over the weekend, and my husband and I decided to take her to Saint Stephen.  We had been before and we enjoyed our previous dining experience immensely.  
We arrived without a reservation, and we were quickly seated.  Our server came over to get our drink order, and we all put in an order for cocktails as well as a bottle of wine we love.  Everything seemed to be off to a great start, until 5 minutes (seriously 5 minutes later), she came to double check with my husband what he had ordered to drink.  We were all confused, she repeated his order, and we expected the drinks to come over soon.  Instead, we waited maybe another 5 minutes for drinks. At this time, everyone was out of water, and no one had been by our table to see what was going on.  A gentleman (assuming another server) came over and dropped off 1 drink to our table. We all looked VERY confused, and I said "I'm sorry, but we had two of these and a Cumberland Blues." The gentleman didn't care and said something along the lines of: "well, here's one, y'all can fight over it." The other two drinks arrived with straws and garnishes, and our server didn't even seem to notice or care that it had taken over 10 minutes at this point.
We asked to order and put our order in.  I also asked if we could go ahead and get our bottle of wine we had asked for. I repeated the name, and region it was from since they have t

I was really looking forward to trying this little restaurant, sometimes the best places are those you find off the beaten path. 

We started with the empanadas. They were crisp outside, a little thick and needed a bit more filling for balance.

The dinners were colorful and looked great.

The challenge is the flavor. The chicken was tender, it was just flavorless. Everything was very bland and we both kept commenting about how the meal would be good if only the food wasn't so bland

It was 90 minutes before closing, maybe that had something to do with the taste of the food. I am going to find and try an alternate Latin restaurant. I have a craving for the amazing flavors I know exist.

On a possitive note the staff was friendly and the location was clean.

I was really excited to experience their FOMO menu - it has a lot of festival foods and glittery things. When we got there we ordered the pitcher of mermaid beer in pink. It wasn't pink, but it was sparkly, so I was satisfied. The waitress asked us to cash out before we even received our food because her shift was over, so we did. Then my boyfriend got his rainbow grilled cheese. It wasn't rainbow. That's right, it was a regular grilled cheese with a marked up price. We managed to catch the waitress before she left and she said she would get a manager. Then she left. We asked two more people before we got someone who actually took the sandwich back to the kitchen to find out what had happened. He came back and told us they were out of food coloring and the cook had assumed it was a regular grilled cheese because of that. Finally, a half hour later the assistant manager came out to speak with us. Because we had already paid (tip and all) they couldn't refund the grilled cheese and gave us another sandwich instead. While all this was happening we asked several people for water, including our waitress, and it was not given to us until after we spoke to the manager. The fries were not great either, but my honey sriracha chicken sandwich was delicious, thankfully. Despite the instagram worthy menu they can't follow through on, we won't be going back.
Always a great experience. Delicious food, yummy wine and a super friendly staff, one of my favorite spots in Tampa!

We loved this restaurant! Fresh off the plane & attending a graduation we were happy to read about it on Yelp. It was also very close to the hotel. Charbroiled oysters, Sunday Pot Roast and peach cobbler. Along with some great NOLA beer it was a perfect way to kick off our vacation!

My husband and I have mentioned going to brunch at Galley Pastry Shop so many times but had zero follow through until last weekend. Wow! We will definitely be back. 

First off, we were a bit surprised how chaotic things were when we arrived. There was not a clear place to put our name in for a table as everyone was standing in the small entrance and claiming they were all waiting to request a table. After we finally got through this process, we decided to get coffee while we waited for our table. This was also a confusing process as there was an employee coming around asking if we needed any drinks but also someone taking orders at the coffee bar. We both ordered a Pear Lavender Latte, which were beyond amazing! I'm fairly certain we would not have been charged for the drinks if we had not went to the front to give our used mugs and advised we needed to pay. 

The wait was rather fast, but we didn't mind since we had our beverages to enjoy. We were seated outside and the area is so relaxing. We both ordered a make your own omelette and a side of fruit. Kudos for having a great assortment of fruit and not the typical melon that many pass off as a fruit option. My omelette was delicious and there were so many items available to add. 

I can't wait to return and try other menu items!

I was very excited to try Cafe Nova after hearing great things from co-workers. We started off with a plate of hummus for the table and it was excellent - especially with the fresh, warm pita bread. 

I ordered the Nova Gyro with fries. It looked and smelled delicious when it arrived. The toppings were all fresh and flavorful, I really enjoyed their tzatziki. Unfortunately, the gyro meat was pretty disappointing. It was so dry and brittle and difficult to chew, even drier than most beef jerky I've had. I had to pick through and remove all of the essentially inedible pieces of meat and wasn't left with much. The server was having a personal conversation with a friend at the bar the entire time and didn't ever come around to ask how the food was. 

Although I was pretty let down, those who ordered other entrees had pretty good looking plates. I may be back but wouldn't return for the Nova Gyro, unfortunate considering that's their staple item.

Really good place! I got the falafel salad and the portion was huge. A lot of lettuce with tomatoes and cucumbers, a generous portion of hummus and 6 big falafels. The falafels were a bit dry but tasted good. A big plus is that nothing was too salty!
